decisions.why: The ticket listed a live port for deletion. processor.go:223 calls it as the nightly mirror read. Deleting it would break the mirror.

decisions.decision: Add make tenancy-guard and wire it into check
decisions.why: Measured zero violations today, so the guard is green from day one and needs no grace period. It locks in the MAG-63 work.

decisions.decision: Rewrite exactly two stale requirements: analytics:96 and charge-session-log:889
decisions.why: telemetry and charging specs have no account-scoping requirement. Their account headings describe polling, which stays correctly account-level.

decisions.decision: Run as one standalone platform- change, not a 2-tier roadmap
decisions.why: The code part is deleting two dead methods. A roadmap's two briefings and two review rounds would cost more than the work.

decisions.decision: Leave the three stale ...ByAccountUpdatedSince comments alone
decisions.why: Project rule: a drifted table comment is not a finding and never justifies a migration to fix comment text.

decisions.decision: Also fix the third stale sentence in the analytics Recent Energy-Per-Kilometre requirement
decisions.why: Verified against reader.go: three of four reads take the vehicle alone. The ticket's Done-when requires no spec teaching the old rule.

decisions.decision: Do NOT drop telemetry.vehicle_snapshots.account_id here; MAG-83 owns it
decisions.why: MAG-83 drops it by omitting it from its new baseline. Doing it here needs two edits MAG-83 then deletes, and would break fresh test containers.

decisions.decision: Fix the battery-pct test read-back instead of restoring SuperchargerHistoryByVehicle
decisions.why: The port has no production caller. Restoring it would keep dead code alive for one test. All four call sites proved order-independent.

decisions.decision: Leader fixed the stale comment at internal/charging/charging.go:443
decisions.why: It named the deleted SuperchargerHistoryByVehicleBetween. A comment pointing at a removed symbol is cross-module fallout the leader owns.
